title: FLA import: motionTweenScale flag not extracted from keyMode
description: In flash8-binary.ts, keyMode is stored as a raw number but only motionSync (bit 0x0800) is extracted. The motionTweenScale flag (which controls whether scaling is tweened during a motion tween) is never extracted. Fix: extract motionTweenScale from keyMode (determine correct bit from Ruffle/flacomdoc reference), add it to Fla8Frame, forward it through flash8-import.ts convertFrame(), and add it to the core Frame model types if not already present. Also ensure it's forwarded in compile.ts or at least preserved as part of the frame data.
